description: Independent hypothetical applications of the same immutable frozen intervention. The frozen decision is no release: only audit and preparation are authorized. The events do not convert preparations into permission to execute clinic exercises or operational rollout. Failures below describe plan limitations and unmet demands, not measured incidents. No resources, experts, fallback procedures or learning from another event are added.

supported_actions.application: Prepare the exception job aid, owner acknowledgement form and two record templates. The frozen ownership assignment concerns overnight overrides; it does not establish who owns this day-shift ambiguous override.
Audit the existing export and denominator definitions, reporting only supported comparisons and annotation coverage; no export results are supplied by this event.
Prepare two clinic slots and recording allocation only; normal day-shift conditions and assistant availability do not confirm attendees or release exercises.
Prepare two attempts and seek the disclosed assessor-review confirmation without administering a check.
Retain the actual advice and its limits without claiming competence or new specialist approval.

unmet_demands: A live day-shift ambiguous override needs an owner, but the frozen plan does not authorize operational rollout or establish an acknowledged day-shift owner.
Attendee confirmation, named overnight acknowledgement and assessor scheduling remain unconfirmed by this event.
plausible_sequence: Ops could prepare the aid and acknowledgement form and record ownership status as unconfirmed where no acknowledgement is supplied.
The analyst could inspect available export fields and leave unsupported values or comparisons unavailable.
The team would keep the clinic and operational rollout withheld under the frozen no-release decision; the event supplies no authorized route to resolve the live override through this intervention.
failures: The intervention does not meet the immediate day-shift ownership demand.
Available AI assistance does not turn prepared practice into released practice or establish exception-handling improvement.
unobserved_outcomes: Whether the override is resolved through pre-existing operations outside this plan.
Actual ownership acknowledgement, audit outputs, clinic attendance or assessor booking.
Exception rates, delays, operational correctness, competence, retention and transfer.

supported_actions.application: Prepare the overnight-owner acknowledgement and job aid, retaining acknowledgement as unconfirmed unless actual evidence exists; prepare exactly two rows without adding a collector.

unobserved_outcomes: What the delayed export ultimately contains or when a usable audit is completed.

Any acknowledgement, substitute staffing, assessor booking, practice delivery or operational resolution outside the frozen plan.
